title: Walsh eta-units at squarefree level-integral structure and Fricke values
summary: For squarefree $M>1$, we determine the quotient of the principal cuspidal lattice of $X_0(M)$ by the sum of its primitive Atkin-Lehner character sublattices. Its invariant factors are explicit at every level. The quotient is a 2-group, and with $k\ge3$ prime divisors its exponent is exactly $2^{k-2}$, the sharp universal power expressing every modular unit, modulo constants, through primitive sign units.
